attributes.board_name: Arizona Regulatory Board of Physician Assistants

rules.accepted_credit_types: Category I CME approved by the American Academy of Physician Assistants, the AMA, the AOA or another accrediting organization acceptable to the board
rules.alternatives: CME requirement is deemed satisfied if, at renewal, the licensee holds a certification in good standing from a certifying body approved by the board (e.g. NCCPA).
rules.audit_note: Board randomly audits at least 10% of renewing PAs each calendar year who do not hold current national certification.

topics.who: PAs authorized to prescribe Schedule II drugs with a DEA registration (or authorized to dispense): opioid-, substance use disorder- or addiction-related CE; counts toward the 40 hours

rules.notes: License renews every other year on or before the birthday; late penalty after 30 days, license expires 90 days after the birthday. Extensions possible for illness, missionary work, foreign residence. Board site (azpa.gov) could not be read; facts from statute.
rules.rule_quote: …including proof of having completed, before the renewal date, forty hours of category I continuing medical education…
